battle.name: 淺水原之戰
battle.brief: 唐武德元年（618）十一月，秦王李世民追西秦薛仁杲至隴東淺水原，步卒結陣於南，精騎伏於原東淺水側，佯退誘敵爭渡，伏兵齊發截其退路，大破薛軍，斬首數千級；仁杲退保折墜城出降，隴西遂定。卡面這具秦弩延續漢唐弩兵傳統，弩手列於陣前齊射壓敵，居高封住退路，使伏騎得以近發。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰雙方：一方是唐王朝新立的討薛軍，統帥為高祖李淵的次子秦王李世民，兵源以關內道各折衝府番上兵為主，雜以秦王府直屬精騎與長安宿衛降編之眾，糧秣自長安向西轉運，並由隴東州縣就地徵芻與粟；編制仍承隋唐府兵之制，步軍以團為最小作戰單位，弓、弩、長槊並用，騎軍以旅為單位，隸屬行軍總管與行軍大將軍之號。另一方是據隴西的西秦政權，其主薛舉於隋大業末年起兵，殺官據縣，自稱漢王，隋亡之後進位稱帝、建立西秦，據涇州與折墜城一帶山地；薛舉同年病死軍中後，由其子薛仁杲嗣位，收攏羌漢邊民與散兵，依附隴右堡寨立柵自守。薛軍屢與北方突厥眉骨咄部相結，得其援騎與馬匹，兵精而地險。關中兵制、兵源與糧道，同隴右的部族武裝，共同構成了這場對峙背後的兩套軍事體系。
countriesEn: The two sides were: on one side, the army raised by the newly founded Tang court to campaign against the Xiqing (Western Qin) regime, commanded in the field by Li Shimin, the Prince of Qin, the second son of the Tang founder Li Yuan. Its strength came mainly from the fubing (household garrison) contingents mustered by the depots of the Guanzhong circuit, mixed with the picked cavalry of the Prince of Qin's own command and with demobilised and regrouped men of the Chang'an palace guards; grain and fodder were shipped west from the capital and supplemented by local requisitions of hay and millet in the eastern Longxi prefectures. The organisation still followed the Sui-Tang fubing system: infantry fought in tuan as the smallest tactical unit, carrying bows, crossbows and long spears together, while cavalry were grouped in smaller detachments under travelling commandants and general-in-chief designations. The other side was the Xiqing regime based in western Longxi. Its leader, Xue Ju, had raised troops in the last years of the Sui, killed officials and seized counties, and proclaimed himself King of Han; after the fall of Sui he took the imperial title and founded the state of Xiqing, holding the mountain country around Jingzhou and Zhezhui city. Xue Ju died of illness in the same year, and his son Xue Rengui succeeded him, gathering frontier Han and Qiang fighters, retired and disbanded soldiers, and fortifying the stockades of the Longyou ravines. The Xue forces repeatedly made contact with the north-eastern Turkic tribes around Meiguoduhu, drawing on their allied horsemen and remounts, so that their troops were hard and their ground defensible. The armies of Guanzhong, with their Sui-Tang household registration, supply lines and levies, set against the tribal armament of the Longyou highlands, formed the two military systems that stood behind this confrontation.
people: 關鍵人物集中在唐方。十七歲起兵、隨父李淵於太原舉事的李世民，在關中初定之後被任命為討薛主帥，總制關內道行軍；他在高墌一線與薛舉相持六十餘日，屢受挫敗仍請戰，終於在淺水原以伏兵與佯退合用取勝，是這場戰役全部的樞紐。父皇李淵坐鎮長安，遣竇抗、竇軌等率關內援軍西趨隴右，並在朝議上定下對薛用兵之策，於是淺水原之役成為唐廷建國初年最被矚目的外征。將領方面，秦王府司騎將軍劉文整為伏兵主將，領精騎潛伏於淺水原東側，待敵軍渡水、陣腳一亂才衝出截斷退路；此役之後他又奉命西行洮州，招撫吐谷渾部眾，替唐爭取到西翼的緩衝。宇文士及奉命挑戰，以少量騎兵反覆擾亂敵陣，消耗薛軍銳氣；竇軌一軍在戰前接戰中失利被俘，竇抗引兵馳援方將其救回。敗方以薛舉、薛仁杲父子為核心：薛舉在位僅數月即病歿於軍中，薛仁杲領兵退保折墜城，淺水原一敗之後不得不再出城請降，兄弟數人隨使者抵達長安，旋遭誅殺。至於秦王府其餘將佐是否直接參與此役，正史與兵書互有出入，諸說並存。
peopleEn: The decisive figures are on the Tang side. Li Shimin, who had risen in arms at seventeen and marched out of Taiyuan with his father Li Yuan, was appointed commander of the expedition against Xue Ju once Guanzhong had been taken, and he directed the operations of the Guanzhong circuit in the field. He fought Xue Ju to a stalemate for more than sixty days at Gaozhi; although he was checked more than once he still pressed for the attack, and it was at Qianshuiyuan, by combining a feigned retreat with an ambush, that he finally won, so that the whole turn of the campaign turned on him. His father Li Yuan remained at Chang'an, sent reinforcements under Dou Kang and Dou Gui towards western Longxi, and settled the court's policy towards the Xue forces, which made the expedition at Qianshuiyuan the most watched foreign campaign of the first years of the Tang. Among the commanders, Liu Wenzheng, cavalry officer of the Prince of Qin, led the ambush: he posted picked cavalry on the eastern side of Qianshuiyuan and charged only when the enemy had forded the water and its order had broken; after the battle he was sent west to Tao-chou to win over the Tuyuhun, securing a buffer on the western flank for the Tang. Yuwen Shiji was charged with provoking engagements, using small bodies of horsemen to disturb the enemy repeatedly and wear down its edge; a detachment under Dou Gui was beaten and its commander taken prisoner in the contact before the battle, and only Dou Kang's charge in force brought him back. On the defeated side the figurehead was the father-and-son pair Xue Ju and Xue Rengui: Xue Ju, who had reigned for only a few months, died of illness in his camp, and Xue Rengui led the troops back to defend Zhezhui city; after the defeat at Qianshuiyuan he had no choice but to come out and surrender, and he and several of his brothers reached Chang'an with the envoys and were put to death soon afterwards. Whether other officers of the Prince of Qin's household actually served at Qianshuiyuan is a matter on which the official histories and the military manuals differ, and several versions of it circulate.
kits: 卡面這具秦弩屬中國弩機一系的早期形制：弩機以木弩臂承力、以銅製機件扣弦，弦滿之後只待扣機便可釋放，是中國在秦代已經成熟的守城與野戰器械，與徒手拉弓相比，可以更久地保持滿弦、連續射擊。從秦到唐，弩手一直是國家軍隊中固定的技術兵種；唐承隋制，府兵步軍以弓弩為主要射擊手段，步卒同時攜槊與盾，騎兵以槊為主幹、弓箭為輔，軍中另有專掌機弩的官署與軍器作坊，弩箭與弩弦按規格配給。淺水原一戰的戰場是隴東黃土高地上的一片平頂原面，唐軍步卒結陣在南，與薛軍隔水相望，這正是弩兵最能施展的地形：居高列陣，穩定齊射，壓住敵方弓手與前鋒，掩護己方騎兵調度；當薛軍爭渡淺水、陣形被水溝切開的一刻，弩手封鎖的射界與伏騎的出奇襲擊互相配合，決定了整場戰鬥。此外，唐軍此役還用到戰馬、長柄大槊、橫刀、盾牌、兜鍪與鎧甲，攻城階段備有巢車、雲梯、投石機與飛雲撞車，糧秣靠車隊與騾馬馱運，馬匹多取自太仆寺監牧。關於淺水原一役的具體配備，原始記載有限，上述為依唐制與同期戰例所作的推斷。
kitsEn: The crossbow shown on this card belongs to the early line of the Chinese crossbow: the trigger mechanism, with a wooden bow arm carrying the tension and a bronze lock holding the string, allows the weapon to be kept fully drawn and fired again at will, and it is a siege and field piece already mature in China by the Qin period; compared with drawing a bow by hand, it can hold its tension far longer and shoot faster. From Qin to Tang the crossbowman remained a fixed technical arm of the state army. The Tang inherited the Sui system, in which bow and crossbow were the principal missile weapons of the infantry of every tuan, the foot soldier carrying at the same time the long spear and the shield, while the cavalry fought mainly with the spear and used bow and arrow in support; the army had offices and workshops charged with the machine crossbows and with the issue of bolts and bowstrings to specification. The field at Qianshuiyuan was an open table of loess plateau in eastern Longxi, with the Tang infantry drawn up on its southern side and the Xue army facing them across the water, and that is exactly the ground on which crossbowmen served best: arrayed on high ground, firing steady volleys, they bore down on the enemy archers and on the advance, covering the redeployment of their own cavalry. At the moment when the Xue troops rushed to ford the shallow water and their formation was cut in two by the channel, the crossbow blockade and the surprise of the mounted ambush interlocked and decided the action. The Tang also brought warhorses, long-handled spears, sabres, shields, helmets and armour, and for the siege they had siege-towers, scaling ladders, stone-throwers and battering rams, with grain carried in wagon trains and on pack mules, and remounts drawn largely from the imperial pastures. Detailed equipment lists for Qianshuiyuan itself survive only in fragments; the above is an inference from Tang regulations and from campaigns of the same years.
tactics: 此役的戰術核心是佯退、伏兵、截路三段合用。唐軍先在隴東高墌一線與薛軍相持六十餘日，穩住陣腳，卻不急於強攻；薛舉病歿、薛仁杲退保折墜城之後，李世民率精兵窮追，把戰場推到薛軍自幼熟悉的淺水原。淺水原是一片高於周圍溝谷的黃土平頂，兩側臨水，道路狹窄，一旦退路被截斷就無處迴旋。開戰時薛仁杲令大將宗羅睺率精兵據原列陣，居高而進；唐軍不與硬拼，以步卒在原南接戰，遣少量騎兵挑戰擾亂，使薛軍銳氣屢挫、陣腳前移，同時把精騎整隊藏於原東淺水側的掩蔽處。兩軍交鋒後唐軍節節後撤，薛軍以為得手，爭先渡水，隊形被淺水切成兩段；此時伏兵齊發，騎兵自側面衝入斷其歸路，唐軍主力乘勢掩殺，斬首數千級，溺死者甚眾，殘部退保折墜城。唐軍隨即攻城數日，施以壓迫並勸降，薛仁杲出降，收其精兵萬餘人。收復之後即派使招撫吐谷渾，切斷薛舉曾經倚賴的外援，再以郡縣與屯田的方式把隴右納入唐的編制。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the battle was the three-part combination of feigned retreat, ambush and cutting the road home. The Tang first held Xue Ju at the line of Gaozhi in eastern Longxi for more than sixty days, steadying their own front without pressing a general assault; after Xue Ju died of illness and Xue Rengui withdrew to defend Zhezhui, Li Shimin pursued him with picked troops, carrying the fighting into Qianshuiyuan, a place the Xue army knew intimately. Qianshuiyuan is a flat table of loess standing above the ravines on either side, with water close on both flanks and narrow approaches, so that once the line of retreat was cut there was nowhere to turn. At the opening of the action Xue Rengui had his general Zong Luohou deploy picked troops on the height to hold the top and press down. The Tang refused to break heads with them: they met the enemy with infantry drawn up south of the plateau and sent small bodies of horsemen forward to provoke and disorder them, wearing out their edge and pulling their formation forward, while the picked cavalry were quietly massed on the eastern side of the plateau beside the shallow water under cover. As the two sides engaged the Tang fell back step by step, and the Xue troops, thinking the day won, crowded to ford the water, so that their order was cut in two by the channel. Thereupon the ambush burst out, the cavalry charged in from the flank to sever their line of retreat, and the main body of the Tang followed the advance and killed them in the open, taking several thousand heads and drowning very many in the water, the survivors falling back to Zhezhui. The Tang then attacked that city for several days, applying pressure and urging surrender, and Xue Rengui came out and surrendered, with more than ten thousand of his picked troops taken over. Once the region was held, envoys were sent to win over the Tuyuhun, cutting off the outside support Xue Ju had relied on, and Longxi was folded into the Tang administration through commanderies, prefectures and garrison farms.
data: 可考的數字有限，且多出自《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》《新唐書》一系的記載，彼此相異之處當存疑。時間上，淺水原之戰記於唐武德元年十一月，合公曆為 618 年 12 月下旬至 619 年 1 月初，個別史籍作十二月。薛舉於隋大業十三年（617）起兵，618 年進位稱帝、建立西秦，同年八月病歿於軍中，另有作九月之說，其子薛仁杲嗣位。戰前李世民與薛軍在高墌一線相持六十餘日。淺水原一戰，《資治通鑑》記斬首數千級、溺死者甚眾；薛仁杲退保折墜城後又戰數日，計所獲降卒精兵萬餘人。地望上，淺水原一線在今陝西長武一帶，另有考證指其地在甘肅涇川、寧縣境內；由長安至此，道路約三四百里，須穿過渭北丘陵與隴東高地的孔道，糧車與騾隊行軍需十餘日。制度面的數字較為確定：唐制一折衝府八百人，以百人為團、五十人為旅，弩、槊、盾為標準配備；古兵書所稱強弩有效射程多在二百至三百步，大型蹶張弩則有數百步之說；而秦弩所屬的弩機一系，戰國至秦漢已見於墓葬出土的銅弩機與秦簡所載的弩律。至於唐軍出動的總兵力、薛軍的兵員以及雙方確切的傷亡數，正史均無可確信的記載，後世流傳的精確數字多屬後人推衍，不宜引用。
dataEn: Survivable figures are few, and most come down to the Zizhi Tongjian and to the Jiu and Xin Tang histories, where the accounts diverge; the divergent readings should be held in reserve. As to time, the battle of Qianshuiyuan is placed in the eleventh month of Wude 1 (618), which corresponds to late December 618 and the opening of January 619, some texts giving the twelfth month. Xue Ju rose in arms in the thirteenth year of Daye (617), took the imperial title and founded Xiqing in 618, and died of illness in his camp in the same year (others say the ninth month), his son Xue Rengui succeeding him. Before the battle, Li Shimin and the Xue army had stood face to face at Gaozhi for more than sixty days. For the action at Qianshuiyuan itself, the Zizhi Tongjian records several thousand heads taken and very many drowned, and after Xue Rengui fell back on Zhezhui and fought for several days more, the picked troops who came over were put at more than ten thousand. As to geography, the Qianshuiyuan line lies around today's Changwu in Shaanxi, other research placing it in the territory of Jingchuan or Ningxian in Gansu; the road from Chang'an thither runs some three or four hundred li and must cross the passes between the hills north of the Wei and the plateau of eastern Longxi, so that a grain convoy with its mule teams needed more than ten days on the march. The institutional figures are more certain: a Tang fubing depot held eight hundred men, in hundreds of tuan and fifties of li, with crossbow, spear and shield as standard issue; ancient military manuals put the effective range of the strong crossbow at two or three hundred paces, with larger foot-tensioned crossbows credited with several hundred; and the trigger mechanism to which the Qin crossbow belongs is already attested in the bronze locks recovered from tombs of the Warring States and Qin periods and in the crossbow regulations preserved among the Qin bamboo strips. As to the total strength the Tang brought into the field, the numbers of the Xue army, and the precise losses on either side, the official histories record nothing that can be relied upon, and the exact figures that circulate in later compilations are mostly reconstructions and should not be quoted.
cause: 起因要從隋末的崩解說起。隋大業年間關中久旱而賦斛征斂不息，役使與兵役並起，隴右的羌漢邊民在薛舉這類邊地首領率領下先後起事，隴西、涇州、天水一線的城邑先後易主，薛軍由山谷屯聚擴為數萬之眾，並與北方突厥相結，取得馬匹與援騎。隋室傾覆、李淵入關建唐之後，關中的新秩序尚未鞏固：西邊是薛氏政權，北邊有劉武周、劉黑闥等勢力窺伺，東邊河北尚在竇建德與王世充的分裂之中。李淵的策略是先固關中、再圖四擊，因此把薛舉視為必須拔除的西面釘子，遂於武德元年遣秦王李世民率關內主力出蒲坂向西，與薛軍在隴東周旋。薛舉恰在戰事最緊要時病歿，兵權由薛仁杲接手；薛仁杲本無其父的聲望與部眾的效忠，退保折墜城後人心已散，唐軍乘勢追擊，遂有淺水原之役。換言之，這場戰爭既是唐初鞏固西疆的必然一步，也是唐廷與西秦在西出通道上的一場決斷性遭遇。
causeEn: The origins have to be traced to the dissolution of the Sui. During the Daye era the Guanzhong region suffered long drought while grain and taxes were levied without respite, corvée and military service were exacted together, and under leaders such as the frontier notable Xue Ju, Qiang and Han border folk of Longyou rose in revolt, the towns of Longxi, Jingzhou and Tianshui changing hands one after another. The Xue forces grew from garrisons in the valleys into a host of tens of thousands, made contact with the Turkic peoples of the north, and obtained horses and allied horsemen. After the Sui fell and Li Yuan entered the pass and founded the Tang, the new order in Guanzhong was not yet secure: to the west stood the Xue regime, to the north the forces of Liu Wuzhou and Liu Heitao were pressing in, and in the east the realm was still split between Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong. Li Yuan's policy was to stabilise Guanzhong first and then strike in several directions, so he treated Xue Ju as the nail that had to be drawn from the western flank, and in the first year of Wude he sent the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, out with the main body of the Guanzhong forces to march west and manoeuvre against the Xue army in eastern Longxi. Xue Ju happened to die at the very moment when the campaign was at its most critical, and command passed to Xue Rengui, who lacked his father's reputation and the loyalty of his troops; after falling back to Zhezhui his men were already scattered, and the Tang pressed the pursuit, which produced the battle of Qianshuiyuan. In short, this war was both an inevitable step in the consolidation of the Tang's western frontier and a decisive encounter between the Tang court and Xiqing on the road west.
impact: 影響有數層。軍事上，西秦覆亡，隴西歸唐，關中最大的西面威脅解除，唐得以把兵鋒轉向北方，隨即在武德二年對付劉武周的進攻，這一轉向的空間正是淺水原之役讓出的。土地與行政上，唐在隴西置慶州等州縣，把隴右的田疇重新編入國家版圖，並以屯田與戍守搭配州縣，取代了割據時代的部族堡寨體系，使隴東至河西的通道重新置於中央調度之下。外交上，招撫吐谷渾、切斷突厥與關中勢力的聯繫，使唐在西北獲得一個緩衝的盟友。聲望上，此役是李世民戰功中最被記誦的一役之一，正史稱其為淺水原之戰，成為後世講述名將用兵的典型母題；他在關中軍中的分量隨之上升，與長兄太子建成之間的權力張力亦隨之加深，間接影響了武德末年玄武門之變的走向。史觀上，此役顯示唐初的府兵制在以關內精兵為核心、以騎兵機動與伏兵奇襲為骨幹的戰法下，能夠迅速吃掉地處險要但兵源雜亂的地方割據勢力，成為其後唐朝平定河北、江南時反覆沿用的模式。
impactEn: The effects worked on several levels. Militarily, Xiqing was destroyed, Longxi returned to the Tang, the gravest western threat to Guanzhong was removed, and the Tang was able to turn its arms northward, meeting Liu Wuzhou's advance in the second year of Wude, and the room to make that turn was exactly what the battle of Qianshuiyuan freed. Administratively, the Tang set up Zhouzhou and other prefectures and counties in Longxi, returned the farmland of eastern Longxi to the registers of the state, and replaced the tribal stockade system of the age of partition with a mixture of garrison farms and garrisons under commanderies and prefectures, so that the corridor from eastern Longxi to Hexi passed once again under central direction. Diplomatically, the winning over of the Tuyuhun and the severing of the Turkic connection with the powers in Guanzhong gave the Tang a buffer ally in the northwest. In terms of renown, this was one of the most celebrated of Li Shimin's martial exploits, recorded in the official histories under the name of the battle of Qianshuiyuan, and it became a standard theme in later accounts of famous commanders; his standing with the armies of Guanzhong rose accordingly, and the tension of authority between him and the crown prince Li Jiancheng deepened with it, indirectly shaping the course of the Xuanwu Gate incident at the end of the Wude era. In historical terms the campaign shows that the early Tang fubing system, built on the picked troops of Guanzhong and on cavalry manoeuvre and mounted ambush as its backbone, could swiftly devour a local separatist force that held strong ground but drew its men from mixed sources, a model the Tang reused repeatedly in the campaigns that brought Hebei and the Jiangnan under its rule.
result: 結果是薛軍的徹底覆滅。淺水原一戰，宗羅睺所率的精兵大潰，斬首數千級、溺死者甚眾，殘部退回合圍之中的折墜城；唐軍追至城下，攻城數日並以勸降相迫，薛仁杲與諸將出降，所部精兵萬餘人被收編改隸唐軍，馬匹器械盡為官府接收。薛仁杲兄弟數人被押送長安，旋遭處決，隴西的西秦政權自此無復存在。取代它的是唐朝在隴東的郡縣與屯田，以及劉文整西行招撫吐谷渾所建立的羈縻聯繫。從較長的時間尺度看，淺水原之役標誌著隋末最大的一支西北割據力量被唐王朝吸收，關中從此取得對隴右的主導權，也為其後數年唐朝統一全國的次序定下西翼先安、然後轉向北方與東方的格局。
resultEn: The outcome was the total destruction of the Xue army. At Qianshuiyuan the picked troops led by Zong Luohou were routed, several thousand heads were taken, very many drowned, and the survivors fell back into Zhezhui, which was already invested. The Tang pursued them to the walls, attacked for several days and pressed for surrender, and Xue Rengui came out with his officers and surrendered, more than ten thousand of his picked troops being taken over and re-enrolled, while his horses and weapons were received into the stores of the state. Xue Rengui and several of his brothers were sent under escort to Chang'an and were put to death soon afterwards, and the Xiqing regime in Longxi ceased to exist. What replaced it was the Tang administration of commanderies and garrison farms in eastern Longxi, together with the dependency relationship established by Liu Wenzheng's mission to the Tuyuhun. On the longer time scale, the battle of Qianshuiyuan marks the absorption of the largest north-western separatist force of the late Sui into the Tang dynasty; from that point Guanzhong held the mastery of the Longyou region, and it fixed the order of Tang unification, with the western wing pacified first and attention then turning north and east.
